import os, pathlib, tempfile

def write_atomic(path, text):
    p = pathlib.Path(path)
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile('w', delete=False, dir=p.parent, encoding='utf-8') as tmp:
        tmp.write(text)
        tmp.flush()
        os.fsync(tmp.fileno())
        name = tmp.name
    os.replace(name, p)

questions.question: Real-world: context manager likho jo operation ki duration measure kare aur slow hone par warn kare.
questions.answer:
import time
from contextlib import contextmanager

@contextmanager
def timed(label, warn_ms=200):
    start = time.perf_counter()
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        ms = (time.perf_counter() - start) * 1000
        state = 'SLOW' if ms > warn_ms else 'ok'
        print(f'{label}: {ms:.1f}ms {state}')
